personality_one_liner: An appetizing, high-quality, and structurally clear food pre-ordering experience that feels warm yet operational.

spacing.rule: Use iOS-native spacing rhythms, generous vertical padding. Thumb zone primary CTAs sticky at bottom. Cards fill horizontal space. Never half-width orphans.

screens.name: Auth
screens.purpose: Log in or sign up securely with JWT.
screens.layout: Clean single column, centered inputs. Sticky 'Continue' CTA at bottom inside KeyboardAvoidingView.

screens.name: Home / Today's Menu
screens.purpose: Discover today's kitchen menu, express interest, and pre-order.

states.loading: Skeleton of featured card and list rows
states.empty: Illustration of empty plate + 'Kitchen is preparing today's menu' + Refresh CTA

screens.layout: Top bar: 'Home Delivery Coming Soon' badge. Hero section: featured dish card with image background, gradient scrim, and title. Below: horizontal scroll category chips, followed by vertical list of menu items. Each item has 'Interested/Not' chips and a 'Pre-Order' button.

screens.name: Order Queue (Live)
screens.purpose: Track live FIFO queue status for placed pre-orders.

states.empty: Empty plate image + 'No active orders' + 'Browse Menu' primary CTA

screens.layout: Current active order visually dominant at top (large status chip, ETA). List-first queue view below showing next 3-5 orders in line. Sticky 'Your position' banner at the bottom with explicit wait time.

screens.name: Custom Request Chat
screens.purpose: Submit and negotiate off-menu requests with the kitchen.

states.empty: Empty state illustration + 'Ask the chef for something special' + CTA to start request

screens.layout: Structured message bubbles. Kitchen responses include inline status chips ('Approved - $15'). Bottom-sheet composer for new requests. Quick-reply suggestion chips above keyboard (e.g., 'Less spicy', 'No dairy').

screens.name: Admin Dashboard
screens.purpose: Manage menu, advance order queue, and reply to requests.
screens.layout: Segmented control at top (Queue | Requests | Menu). Queue: swipe-to-advance actions on list items. Requests: Chat threads with 'Reply & Set Price' bottom sheet. Menu: Add/edit today's dishes.

empty_queue.alt: Empty plate with fork and knife

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all buttons are wrapped in standard Pressable with min 44x44pt hitSlop. Do not use TouchableOpacity.
Implement 'Home Delivery Coming Soon' as a glassmorphism banner on the Home screen to build anticipation.
For the Custom Request Chat, implement structured message bubbles where admin responses can contain a distinct price approval chip, rather than just text.
On the Live Queue screen, ensure the 'current order' is visually distinct from the rest of the FIFO list.
Follow the defined iOS-Native Clean spacing (generous vertical padding, cards fill horizontal space).
All images with text overlaid must have a vertical gradient scrim (transparent to 70%+ surfaceInverse).
Never use indigo, violet, or blue across the app. Stick strictly to the warm Terracotta/Ochre palette provided.
Ensure the primary pre-order CTA on the menu screen is sticky at the bottom, outside the scroll view.
